label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app

label: cvrus67.github.io/rixz-murbug

label: reward-2.vercel.app
title: Daily Rewards App - Earn Coins & Prizes
reasons: The page is a rewards app that requires a "Withdrawal Processing Fee (%)" before users can claim promised earnings — a classic advance-fee mechanism where the operator collects fees against funds the site cannot and will not pay out.
The page connects to Telegram (t.me) as an operational channel, typical of reward scam infrastructure for operator-victim communication.
The app promises "Earn Coins & Prizes" but gates withdrawal behind a fee field (withdrawalFee), soliciting money under a false premise legible on the page itself.
